name: r002-cross-match-v1
route: Initial; up to three cycles of two signal calls, return and use; no-new/no-open stop; gate before cycle 3 replaces signal slots on stall; one closing return after last completed cycle. Fatal failure ends occurrence; no padding, repair, fallback or retry.
manipulated_link: Matched prose-objection comparator for the tested-objection decisiveness intervention.
limitations: This is not the shipped R001 cross-family recipe.
A schema adapter must allow prose objections without enforcing the proposed check object while retaining all other matched fields.
After amendments LOOP-CROSS shares this envelope. Optional CROSS-MATCH is a separately receipted replication, not an extra independent causal contrast.

stall_switch.trigger: after cycle 2: canonical decisive claim values equal after cycles 0,1,2 AND an objection remains open
stall_switch.equality: canonical JSON by required relation ID, missing/unparseable equals unknown; no semantic score
stall_switch.select_open: lowest fork step_index, then immutable objection ID; no oracle lookup
stall_switch.strategy: same-lineage branch-first recoding for signal_a; same-lineage carrier solve for signal_b; compare/check via normal return
stall_switch.no_new_objections_precedence: stop only if no new objection AND no open objection; an open objection forbids the no-new stop

fork_contract.critic: earliest public derivation step with exact quote and reason
fork_contract.return: full public rederivation from challenged step for uptake; tail edit is non-uptake
fork_contract.rivals: named public branch point and alternative method only; no generic alternatives

output_contract.qualification: every critic must complete a contract-shaped offline fixture; live missing/length output is censored and bars lineage/blindness attribution
